en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
When you are brought the bread and the meat, so begin with the bread, so close by it the emptiness of the hunger, then eat the meat’.
en.sarwar: 7. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated: “He (the Imam) has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘
When bread and meat is brought for you, eat bread first to stop the emptiness of hunger, then eat the meat.’”
